subject: Deep Generative Models
syllabus_context: Unit V: Generative Deep Learning. Unsupervised representation learning, dimensionality reduction, structural failure modes of fully connected and convolutional autoencoders, continuous latent space geometry, Gaussian prior modeling, KL divergence regularization, reparameterization trick.
declared_learning_objective: Explain why classical autoencoders fail at smooth generative interpolation, derive the variational autoencoder objective mapping inputs to Gaussian distributions (mu, sigma^2), and justify the role of Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence in regularizing the latent space.

provenance.source: KMIT Faculty Lecture Series (Asha Mam, Units GT-A01 to GT-A03)
provenance.institution: Keshav Memorial Institute of Technology, Hyderabad

recording_quality.known_observability_limitations: Colloquial speech patterns transcribed verbatim; mathematical formulas referenced verbally.
